questions.question: What anthropological concept describes the idea that humans, through their free will, have the ability to choose between good and evil, and that this choice is crucial for their salvation?
choices: A: The doctrine of original sin
C: The Catholic belief in providence
questions.explanation: Free will is a central concept in many theological discussions, especially in Christianity, and is considered the ability of humans to make moral decisions that can influence their salvation. The idea that the choice between good and evil is significant for spiritual salvation is found in various religious traditions.

Which of the following fermentation types is known for enabling the conversion of sugar into alcohol and carbon dioxide?
questions.explanation: Ethanol fermentation is a biological process in which yeast converts sugar into alcohol and carbon dioxide. This method is fundamental for the production of alcoholic beverages such as beer and wine and plays a central role in many cultural food production traditions.

questions.question: Which capital city belongs to the country Fiji?
questions.explanation: Suva is the capital of Fiji and is located on the southern coast of the main island Viti Levu. The city is the political and administrative center of the country and plays an important role in Fiji's economy and culture.

questions.question: Which agreement was signed in 1992 to liberalize trade between the USA, Canada, and Mexico?
questions.explanation: The North American Free Trade Agreement (NAFTA) came into effect in 1994 and was signed in 1992. It aims to reduce trade barriers between the three countries and promote economic exchange.

questions.question: Which artist is known for the development of Cubism?
questions.explanation: Pablo Picasso, along with Georges Braque, is considered one of the founders of Cubism, an art movement that emerged in the early 20th century and uses geometric shapes to represent objects. Cubism revolutionized the way artworks are constructed and perceived.

questions.question: Which animal is known for adapting to various habitats over millennia and is found in many regions of the world today?
questions.explanation: The wolf is an excellent example of evolutionary adaptability. It has adapted to various habitats and is widespread in many parts of the world. In contrast, the other mentioned animals are extinct and therefore do not have adaptations for current habitats.

What happens when an athlete starts prematurely at an athletics starting signal?
choices: A: He can continue running if he does not take more than three steps.
D: A new starting signal is given.
questions.explanation: In athletics, an athlete is disqualified for a false start if they start before the signal. This is done to ensure fair competition conditions and give all athletes an equal chance to start the race.

questions.question: What is the Spanish word for 'hello'?
questions.explanation: 'Hola' is the standard greeting in Spanish, equivalent to 'hello' in English. The other options are common Spanish words but do not mean 'hello.'

questions.question: Which of the following operating systems is known for its open-source license?

What does Newton's law of motion describe?
choices: A: The mass of a body remains constant no matter where it is.
B: The speed of a body always changes proportionally to time.
C: A body remains at rest or moves uniformly unless a net force acts on it.
D: Energy cannot be created or destroyed, only converted.
questions.explanation: The first Newton's law, also known as the law of inertia, states that a body only changes its direction or speed of motion when a force acts upon it. This explains the behavior of stationary or uniformly moving objects under the influence of forces.
